Title: "Add to cart" shows an error message although the item is added
Expected: A confirmation such as "Product added to shopping cart."
Actual: A red message appears: "Oeps, something went wrong." Yet the item was added — the cart icon in the header now shows 1.
Priority reason: Every shopper who adds an item is told it failed; expect repeat clicks, duplicate items and abandoned carts.

Title: The cart shows $00.00 as every line total
Steps:
1. Open https://with-bugs.practicesoftwaretesting.com/#/product/1 and click Add to cart.
2. Open the cart with the cart icon in the header.
3. Change the quantity to 3 and press Tab.
Expected: The line total shows $14.15 at quantity 1 and $42.45 at quantity 3.
Actual: The line total shows $00.00 at every quantity. The cart total below it is correct ($14.15, then $42.45).
Priority reason: Every order shows $00.00 per line on the last screen before paying; shoppers can't check what they pay for.

Title: Contact form can't be sent — every subject is rejected
Steps:
1. Open https://with-bugs.practicesoftwaretesting.com/#/contact.
2. Enter First name Demo, Last name Tester, Email demo.tester@example.com.
3. Choose the subject Webmaster.
4. Enter a 73-character message: This is a demo message written for a QA sample report on a practice site.
5. Click Send.
Expected: The message is sent and a confirmation appears.
Actual: "Subject is required" appears under the Subject field — which still shows "Webmaster" — and nothing is sent. The same happens with every one of the 8 subjects in the list.
Priority reason: No visitor can send a message at all; order, return and payment questions never arrive.

Title: "Home" in the header opens the Contact page
Steps:
1. Open https://with-bugs.practicesoftwaretesting.com/#/rentals.
2. Click Home in the header.
Expected: The home page with the product list opens.
Actual: The Contact page opens (address ends in #/contact), and "Home" is highlighted as the current page while you are on Contact.
Priority reason: Visitors who use Home to get back to the products land on the contact form instead.

Title: "Add to cart" and "Add to favourites" overlap on product pages
Steps:
1. Open https://with-bugs.practicesoftwaretesting.com/#/product/1 on a desktop (1280 px wide).
2. Repeat on a phone-sized screen (390 px wide).
Expected: Two separate buttons side by side, each label fully readable.
Actual: The buttons overlap by 50 px at 1280 px wide, hiding most of the "Add to cart" label ("Add t…"). The same happens on a phone.
Priority reason: The main button on every product page is half hidden; it still works when clicked.

Title: The shop logo and the Search icon don't load
Expected: The shop logo (top left) and the icon beside "Search" are displayed.
Actual: Both show as broken images on every page; the image they point at doesn't exist on the server (404 Not Found).
Priority reason: The logo is missing on every page; nothing stops working.

Title: "Chainsaws" in the Categories menu opens a "Page Not Found" error
Steps:
1. Open https://with-bugs.practicesoftwaretesting.com/#/.
2. Open Categories in the header.
3. Click Chainsaws.
Expected: The category opens with its products.
Priority reason: A main-menu entry leads to an error page.

Title: Every sort option sorts in the opposite direction
Steps:
1. Open https://with-bugs.practicesoftwaretesting.com/#/.
2. In Sort, choose "Name (A - Z)" and look at the first product.
3. Choose "Price (Low - High)" and look at the first price.
Expected: "Name (A - Z)" starts with Adjustable Wrench; "Price (Low - High)" starts with the cheapest product.
Actual: "Name (A - Z)" starts with Wood Saw (Z to A). "Price (Low - High)" starts with Cordless Drill 20V at $125.23, the most expensive. All six options are reversed, including Name (Z - A), Price (High - Low) and both CO₂ options.
Priority reason: Shoppers who sort get the opposite order; the list still shows every product.

Title: The + and − quantity buttons do nothing
Actual: The quantity stays at 1. The − button has no effect either.
Priority reason: Shoppers can't pick a quantity on the product page; they can still change it in the cart.

Title: Spelling errors in the interface
Steps:
1. Open the home page #/ — look at the header and the left column.
2. Open a product page #/product/1 — look below the product.
3. Open the contact page #/contact — look at the message box.
Expected: Contact · Sort · Search · Related products · Message
Actual: "Contakt" (header, every page) · "Sorth" (product list) · "Serch" (search button) · "Reltded products" (product page) · "Massage" (contact form)
Priority reason: Looks careless on every page; nothing stops working. Quick to fix.

Title: The Categories menu has an "UNDEFINED" entry that opens an empty page
Steps:
1. Open https://with-bugs.practicesoftwaretesting.com/#/.
2. Open Categories in the header.
3. Click UNDEFINED.
Expected: Every menu entry names a real category and opens its products.
Actual: The entry reads "UNDEFINED" and opens "Category: Undefined" (#/category/undefined) with no products.
Priority reason: A visible broken entry in the main menu that leads to an empty page.

Title: The default $1–$100 price filter is shown but not applied
Steps:
1. Open https://with-bugs.practicesoftwaretesting.com/#/ — the Price Range filter shows $1 to $100.
2. Click Next to page 3 of the results.
Expected: Only products priced between $1 and $100 are listed while the filter shows $1–$100.
Actual: Three products above $100 are listed — Cordless Drill 20V ($125.23), Cordless Drill 18V ($119.24) and Random Orbit Sander ($100.79).
Priority reason: The filter shown doesn't match the list; shoppers see a few more products than expected.

Title: The contact form doesn't flag an invalid email address
Steps:
1. Open https://with-bugs.practicesoftwaretesting.com/#/contact.
2. Enter not-an-email as the email address and leave the other fields empty.
3. Click Send.
Expected: An error such as "Email format is invalid" next to the email field.
Actual: The empty fields show errors; the email field shows none.
Priority reason: Matters once the form works again: mistyped addresses arrive with no way to reply.

Title: The subject list offers two error messages as subjects
Expected: Only real subjects — Customer service, Webmaster, Return, Payments, Warranty, Status of my order.
Actual: Two entries read "Error 101: Subject not found" and "Error 202: Translation error".
Priority reason: Looks broken; a visitor may pick an error as their subject.
